_readme: Operator price list for the Extraction Agent: what each model call costs Memora.
Edited only by whoever runs Memora (reviewed in git); no API or console can change it.
Add a NEW version with a later effective_from to change prices -- never edit an old one,
so past costs stay explainable. Units: USD. Any mix of input_per_1m, output_per_1m,
per_image (layout/vision calls send one image each), per_call; or free: true.
The newest version in force is used on its own, so it must list every provider/model.
A model missing from the file is recorded at $0 with price = null, so it stands out.
nemotron-3-super: $0.30 / $0.90 per 1M tokens as listed for Nebius (Sept 2026).
nemotron-parse and nemotron-3-nano-omni on Nebius: fill in from tokenfactory.nebius.com/models.
TEST PRICES: build.nvidia.com is really free. The 2026-09-24 build-nvidia rates are made up
so cost calculation can be exercised during development. Before the demo, add a new
version that sets build-nvidia back to { "*": { "free": true } }.
